title: power_model.json
description: 29 §2-3 — PlayerPower formula weights, reference opponent, pet ability weights, Utility Index weights.

model.description: 29 §2.1 — both forms ship so the change is reversible without a client patch. 'geometric' is the default and every table in 29 is authored against it.

kPower.description: 29 §2.1 — pure calibration constant with no design meaning, fixed once by solving PlayerPower(referenceParBuild) = 1000. null until the harness derives it.

kPowerExpectedMagnitude.description: 29 §2.1 — expected magnitude of kPower (approx 5.3). A derived kPower far from this means the reference par build or the formula has drifted.

referenceOpponent.description: 29 §2.2 — fixed reference opponent, defined once and never varied by chapter. This is what makes PlayerPower an absolute, comparable scalar.

mitigation.description: 29 §2.3 / 05 §4 — MitigationVsReference = effDef / (effDef + flatConstant + perLevelConstant * level). 05 §3 calls these the two most important balance dials in the game.

petAbilityWeights.description: 29 §2.4 — per-ability weight table so pets with non-damage actives (shields, heals, FREEZE) contribute to EffectiveHP rather than being ignored. Empty until the pet catalogue is authored (M3).

utilityIndex.description: 29 §3.1 — the second, cruder scalar covering everything PlayerPower deliberately excludes. Never shown to the player.

dieFaceWeights.description: 29 §3.1 — sum of per-face weights. Only the two endpoints (Star=1.0, Pip1=0.05) are authored in the design docs; the rest are null. Face kinds are the 04 §1 DieFaceKind enum.
